profile.name: Mantou / Faith
profile.intro: Engineer by background, builder by curiosity, founder by choice. Exploring cloud, AI infrastructure, and products that solve real-world problems.
profile.about: I started in audiovisual and collaboration engineering, working across system design, integration, troubleshooting, and customer-facing technical roles. Today, I work at the intersection of engineering, cloud infrastructure, and entrepreneurship. I founded HTIFA to help international teams get operational work done on the ground in Taiwan. Outside work, I build and experiment with software, from developer tools and AWS learning resources to small internet products. I enjoy connecting physical systems with digital ones—and turning ideas into useful things.
